GRANULES.NS.d: Granules India Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical formulation intermediates, and finished dosages (FDs) in India and internationally. The company's APIs in various therapeutic categories include anti-retrovirals, anti-hypertensives, anti-histamines, anti-infectives, analgesics, anti-coagulants, anti-fibriotics, and platelet inhibitors.

IGCL.NS.d: Indogulf Cropsciences Limited produces and distributes agricultural products, including crop protection agents, plant nutrition products and biological inputs, to individual and institutional customers in India and abroad. Its crop protection range covers plant growth regulators, fungicides, herbicides and insecticides.

IIFL.NS.d: IIFL Finance Limited provides various financial products and services in India and internationally. The company offers home, personal, and gold loans; business loans, including loans against property, medium and small enterprise financing, micro finance, developer and construction finance, real estate finance, and capital market finance; and digital finance.

INOXINDIA.NS.d: INOX India Limited makes and supplies cryogenic liquid storage and transport tanks to gas companies and EPC firms in India and abroad. Its range also includes industrial gas equipment such as microbulk units and vaporizers, oil and gas equipment, liquid nitrogen containers, gas cylinders, cryogenic process technologies and propulsion systems, and equipment for fusion and superconducting projects.

INTERARCH.NS.d: Interarch Building Products Limited, set up in 1983 with its head office in Noida, provides pre-engineered steel construction solutions. It undertakes pre-engineered steel building (PEB) contracts and also makes metal ceiling and roofing systems, among them suspended ceilings, cladding and roofing.

IRIS.NS.d: IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited is a holding company offering software for analytics, data management and regulatory compliance. It has three segments: Collect, centred on its regulatory platform; Create, covering its enterprise platform; and Consume.

LANDSMILL.NS.d: Landsmill Green Limited, incorporated in 2003 and based in Mumbai, works in IT-enabled business process outsourcing, infrastructure projects and general trading. Its BPO segment provides customer care by handling inbound and outbound client interactions. Initially called Excel Realty N Infra Limited, it took its current name in December 2025.

MAITHANALL.NS.d: Maithan Alloys Limited manufactures and exports ferro alloys in India and internationally. The company offers ferro silicon, ferro manganese, and silicon manganese products. It is also involved in the generation and supply of wind power. The company serves steel companies. Maithan Alloys Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Burdwan, India.

MBEL.NS.d: M & B Engineering Ltd., established in 1981 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, designs, manufactures and installs prefabricated metal structures, steel roofing systems and complex steel components. It fabricates structural steel for bridges, flyovers, power plants and other industrial uses, serving sectors including food and beverage, warehousing, power, textiles and railways.

NAVNETEDUL.NS.d: Navneet Education Limited publishes state board publication books and stationary products. The company operates through three segments: Publication, Stationery, and Others. The Publishing segment consists of supplementary books, such as workbooks, guides, and question banks, which are based on the latest prescribed syllabus by state education boards under the Vikas and Gala brand names. The Stationery segment offers paper based and non-paper based stationery under the Navneet and Youva brand names.

NRAIL.NS.d: N R Agarwal Industries Limited develops, manufactures, and sells finished paper products in India. The company offers grey back and white back duplex boards for gravure printing, embossing, and foil stamping; writing and printing papers; and newsprint products. Its products are primarily used in FMCG packaging, textbooks and notebooks, and print media applications. The company exports its products to approximately 36 countries.

NYKAA.NS.d: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited and its subsidiaries sell and distribute beauty, personal care and fashion goods for women, men, kids and the home, in India and abroad. Its range covers makeup, skin and hair care, wellness, fragrance, clothing, footwear, bags, jewellery, home decor and kitchen items, sold online and through physical stores and general trade.

PLATIND.NS.d: Platinum Industries Limited makes and sells chemical components to Indian and overseas customers, including PVC stabilizers, CPVC additives and lubricants. Its stabilizers include lead-based and hybrid types and complete additive packages, as well as non-lead calcium-zinc and organic alternatives. Mumbai is its headquarters, and it dates from 2016.

RKSWAMY.NS.d: R K Swamy Limited, set up in Mumbai in 1973, provides marketing solutions in India and abroad. Its three divisions are integrated marketing communications, customer data analytics with marketing technology, and full-service market research. The first division creates advertising content for television, cinema, digital, radio and print, along with point-of-sale and brochure materials, and handles media planning.

SASKEN.NS.d: Sasken Technologies Limited provides product engineering and digital transformation services worldwide. Its services include test automation, consultancy, test specifications, product testing, and application testing; and platform development and sustenance, mobility, data analytics, Internet of Things, and blockchain services to digital solutions.

SECMARK.NS.d: SecMark Consultancy Limited, established in 2011 and based in Mumbai, is a subsidiary of Secmark Holdings Private Limited that provides consulting, technology and outsourcing services. It mainly helps financial market participants with regulatory compliance, operations, software development and risk management, and also offers IT infrastructure management, security audits, forensics, legal counsel, HR solutions and specialized software.

SHRJAGP.NS.d: Shri Jagdamba Polymers Limited is an Indian company involved in the manufacturing of polypropylene (PP) woven sacks and fabrics. They cater to the packaging needs of various industries. The company is based in India.

SOUTHWEST.NS.d: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited provides drilling, exploration, and allied services to coal, ferrous, nonferrous, and atomic and base metal mining; and water and unconventional energy industries in India. It offers coal and mineral exploration services, such as wireline core drilling, reverse circulation drilling, large diameter drilling, directional drilling; and coal bed methane exploration and production drilling services.

TBI.NS.d: TBI Corn Ltd. operates within the corn milling industry, specializing in the manufacturing, supply, and export of a diverse range of corn-based products. Its primary offerings include various grades of corn grits, corn flour, raw corn flakes, corn germ, broken maize, and corn bran. The company serves a broad spectrum of industries, including the food and beverage sectors, providing essential ingredients for breakfast cereals, snack foods, sweets, confectionery, bakeries, and the hospitality sector.

VIKRAN.NS.d: Vikran Engineering Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VIKRAN and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VLEGOV.NS.d: VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Limited, headquartered in Mumbai and founded in 2016, delivers system integration and IT-enabled services for India's e-governance initiatives. Its two segments are E-Governance and IT/ITES, and the Vakrangee Kendra business, which manages a network of physical retail outlets called Nextgen Vakrangee Kendras.

WILLAMAGOR.NS.d: Williamson Magor & Co. Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company also engages in the investments and lending activities. Further, it provides rent, maintenance, and management consultancy services. The company was founded in 1868 and is based in Kolkata, India.
